info.name: Outmanage API Tests
info.description: Test collection for Outmanage API with valid and invalid request examples to test error handling and logging

request.description: This request retrieves all active users with their roles using pagination. Default values: page=1, limit=10. It should return a 200 status with an array of user objects and pagination metadata.

response.name: Success Response

item.name: Get Role by ID - Invalid ID Format

request.description: This request tests error handling with an invalid ID format. It should return a 400 status with error details about the invalid ID.

item.name: Get Role by ID - Role Not Found

request.description: This request tests error handling for a non-existent role ID. It should return a 404 status with error details.
This request creates a new role with valid data. It should return a 201 status with the created role object.
This request tests error handling when trying to create a role with a name that already exists. It should return a 409 Conflict status.
This request tests validation when creating a role without the required name field. It should return a 400 Bad Request status.
This request updates a role with valid data. It should return a 200 status with the updated role object.
This request tests error handling when trying to update a role with a name that already exists. It should return a 409 Conflict status.
This request tests error handling when trying to update a non-existent role. It should return a 404 Not Found status.
This request hard deletes a role that is not associated with any users. It should return a 200 status with the deleted role object.

This request tests hard deleting a role that has only archived users associated with it. It should succeed and automatically set the roleId to null for all archived users that were associated with this role.
This request tests error handling when trying to delete a role that is associated with active users. It should return a 409 Conflict status.

response.name: Role in Use Response

request.description: This request tests error handling when trying to delete a non-existent role. It should return a 404 Not Found status.
